seo_title: Multi-Delivery API Integration for Restaurants | SMEs
seo_desc: Is your restaurant chaotic with too many delivery tablets? We integrate cloud APIs to unify all your delivery orders into your own B2B POS.
author_pitch: I have seen restaurant owners go crazy with three tablets ringing at once and orders getting lost in the kitchen. I build Cloud integrations that unify all delivery platforms into your POS, so your team stops doing data entry and focuses on cooking.
title: Multi-Delivery API Integration: Unify Your Restaurant Orders and Eliminate Chaos
body:
Does your counter look like a telephone switchboard with three different tablets ringing at the same time?

For small restaurants and takeout businesses, being on Glovo, Uber Eats, and Just Eat is mandatory to survive. The problem is that each platform works in isolation. When an order comes in, a waiter has to stop serving customers to read the tablet and manually type the order into the local POS so the ticket reaches the kitchen. This bottleneck generates mistakes when copying dishes, monumental delays, and furious customers in your dining room.

The trap of Generic Monthly Aggregators

Hiring a third-party SaaS that charges you monthly commissions for unifying orders only adds another expensive middleman that does not integrate perfectly with your legacy cash register software. Paying eternal technological tolls chokes the slim margin of modern hospitality.

Our solution: Cloud API Multi-Delivery Middleware

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we develop a cloud middleware layer designed specifically for your small business. We directly connect the official APIs of the delivery platforms with your current POS database, unifying the entire workflow on a single screen without abusive monthly fees.

  1. Direct POS Injection: Orders from any platform enter directly into your cash register system as if a waiter had typed them, automatically sending the ticket to the kitchen.
  2. Centralized Menu Synchronization: If you run out of an ingredient or change the price of a burger on your POS, the API instantly updates your menu across all delivery apps at once.
  3. Smart Modifier Mapping: We resolve the chaos of "no onion" or "extra cheese" by translating the modifiers from each app into the exact format your hospitality software understands.
  4. Automatic Saturation Pausing: We configure cloud rules so that, if your kitchen receives more than a certain number of orders, the API temporarily pauses your restaurant on the apps to prevent collapse.

The Real Impact on Your Restaurant

  • Elimination of human error: No more complaints about wrong orders or ignored allergies; the kitchen receives the exact information the customer selected on their mobile.
  • Staff time recovery: Your waiters stop acting as technological paper pushers and return to focusing on providing excellent service to your dine-in customers.
  • Zero redundant hardware: Get rid of the tablet collection on your counter. You will operate your entire digital and physical business from your usual single screen.
